parameters.common_support: geometry valid AND finite in all three features; unchanged under shifts
parameters.auc: weighted Mann-Whitney U, exact-score ties receive half credit; no orientation selection

null.interpretation: Spatial-misalignment diagnostic, not valid FWER control or a significance proof: conditional ROI selection, model reference and nonstationarity remain
null.translations: uniform unique nonzero toroidal offsets independently per case; no near-identity exclusion or redraw
null.rank_definition: (1 + count(null maximum over two feature macro AUCs >= observed feature macro AUC)) / (null_replicates + 1)

bootstrap.interpretation: Paired descriptive block interval for these three fields; not independent donor uncertainty
bootstrap.draws_layout: case, replicate, draw; blocks indexed row-major
